name: Autoscaling (boot takes time)
description: The API servers normally run 2 instances and add more when they are over 60% busy (up to 12). They check once a minute; a new instance takes 2 minutes to boot and is slower for its first 20 seconds (cold start). At minute 5 the traffic triples; the new instances catch up only 3 minutes later, and about 30% of requests fail in that time. While instances boot, the checks still see "not enough", so a few too many are added; they are removed only after 5 minutes in a row of not needing them (the scale-down stabilization window). Try a boot time of 10 seconds (pre-warmed instances) or 5 minutes.
